ctaHeading: Ready to upgrade your Bundoora garden?
aboutText: Time to Upgrade! has been transforming outdoor spaces across Bundoora and Melbourne's north for over a decade. Our qualified landscapers specialise in complete garden makeovers, from design through to installation. Whether you need a full landscape redesign, a new deck, or fresh turf, we deliver quality craftsmanship tailored to your Bundoora property. We take pride in creating outdoor spaces that families love spending time in.
servicesText: From initial design to final touches, Time to Upgrade! handles every aspect of your landscaping project. We work with Bundoora homeowners and businesses to create functional, beautiful outdoor spaces that stand the test of time.

services.title: Garden Makeovers
services.desc: Complete transformation of tired, outdated gardens into stunning outdoor spaces tailored to your Bundoora property.

services.title: Landscaping Design
services.desc: Professional landscape planning and design that maximises your outdoor area's potential and suits your lifestyle.

services.title: Decking & Pergolas

services.title: Retaining Walls

services.title: Turf & Garden Beds
services.desc: Fresh lawn installation and garden bed creation using quality turf and plants suited to Melbourne's climate.

services.title: Outdoor Features
services.desc: Paving, edging, garden lighting and decorative elements that complete your outdoor upgrade.
